name: In Front of Me
source:
M/C asks his friend, Dallas, why she thinks he's never been in a relationship. She ponders the thought, and in response she introduces him to her friends Kelsey and Olivia. Can he actually find something special between these two? Or perhaps someone else...

A short visual novel about friendship and love.

[Edited from [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=45697]Lemma Soft[/url]]
translation:
M/C问他的朋友达拉斯，为什么她认为他从未谈过恋爱。她思考了这个想法，然后将他介绍给她的朋友凯尔西和奥利维亚。他真的能在这两个人之间找到一些特别的东西吗？或者也许是其他人…

一部关于友情和爱情的短篇视觉小说。

[编辑自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=45697]Lemma Soft[/url]]
